The has_aes flag is determined at module import time based on whether AES crypto libraries (pycrypto or jcecrypto) are available in the runtime environment.
sink_summary: When the condition evaluates to true (no AES support but encrypt_key provided), an InvalidCryptoBackendError is raised, preventing encrypted cookie sessions from being created in environments lacking AES support.
guard_summary: The guard is effective - it prevents creation of encrypted sessions when AES crypto libraries are not available. The check occurs early in the CookieSession constructor before any session data processing begins.
risk_pattern: If a system requires encrypted session cookies but lacks AES crypto libraries, attempting to create an encrypted session will raise an exception rather than silently failing or creating unencrypted sessions.
